name: Dumas Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single residence with a gray roof and a smaller detached structure|A paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the house|A large open lawn occupies most of the lot|Mature trees form a dense border along the sides and rear|Neighboring agricultural land and scattered homes are visible around the parcel.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence faces the street, with a paved driveway and a green lawn between the road and the house|The house has a gray roof and light-colored walls|A detached structure sits in the rear lawn|Dense mature trees stand along the sides and behind the house|Landscaped shrubs sit near the front of the residence.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows a large open lawn bordered by dense mature trees|The residence and a detached structure are visible toward the rear|A paved driveway runs along the right edge of the frame|No clear side path is visible through the trees.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows a large open lawn with dense mature trees along the far edge|The residence is partially visible in the distance|A road runs along the right side of the frame|The detached structure behind the house is partially visible.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the house with a gray roof, a paved driveway, and a green lawn|A detached structure sits in the lawn|Dense mature trees stand along the rear and right edge|Open lawn extends between the house and the tree line.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from Cole View Dr to the front of the house. The site is a single-family residence on a large lot with an open lawn and dense mature trees bordering the sides and rear. Tree cover may limit sightlines and movement along the perimeter. A detached structure is present. No gates are visible on the driveway from the imagery. Neighboring agricultural land and scattered homes sit on adjacent parcels.
